helpIntro: Pick a short guide. It shows you each part of the screen, one at a time.

welcome.title: A quick look around
welcome.hint: What is on the first screen

addEntry.title: Adding money in or out
addEntry.hint: Write down something you paid or got

hello.title: Welcome!
hello.body: This short guide shows you around. It takes one minute, and you can close it at any time with ✕.

spent.title: This month
spent.body: How much you spent this month. Tap it to see where the money went.

money.title: Our money
money.body: The money you have now, in cash and in the bank. Tap it to see each one.

add.title: The + button
add.body: Tap + every time you pay for something or get money. This is the button you will use most.

history.title: History
history.body: Every entry you wrote down. Find one here to change or delete it.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Simple charts of where your money goes, month by month.

help.title: Help is always here
help.body: Tap ? on any screen to see this guide again, or a guide for that screen.

plus.title: Start with +
plus.body: Tap + at the bottom of any screen. Let's open it together.

type.title: Money out or in?
type.body: Money out is for things you paid. Money in is for money you got. Move is for money going from one wallet to another.

amount.title: Type the amount
amount.body: Use these big number keys. You can even add up a receipt, like 120 + 85.

category.title: What was it for?
category.body: Tap here and choose what the money was for, like Food or Bills.

details.title: Wallet and day
details.body: Which wallet paid, and on which day. Today is already chosen. You can add a short note too.

save.title: Save
save.body: Tap Save and you are done. If you made a mistake, tap Undo on the message that appears.

search.title: Search
search.body: Type a word or an amount to find an entry quickly.

period.title: Which month
period.body: Go back and forth in time. Tap the middle to show a day, a week, a month or a year.

filter.title: Show only some entries
filter.body: Show only money out or money in, or only one category or wallet.

list.title: Tap an entry to change it
list.body: Tap any entry to fix it or delete it. Deleted entries can be brought back from Settings for 30 days.

tabs.title: Three ways to look
tabs.body: Overview is the short summary. All reports has a list of ready reports. Breakdown is a detailed table.

overview.title: Where your money went
overview.body: Tap any part of the chart or a category to see the entries in it. Swipe sideways for the last 6 months.

lists.title: Your lists
lists.body: Change categories, wallets, budgets, monthly entries and savings goals here.

more.title: More settings
more.body: Switch between English and Arabic, and download a copy of your entries.

support.title: Need a hand?
support.body: Write to us here, with a screenshot if you like, and we will help.
